paper_metadata.title: Effect of g' content on the mechanical behavior of the WASPALOY alloy system

evidence.quote: WASPALOY has been extensively applied in different industries such as aircraft, chemical-plant equipment and petrochemical equipment. It can be considered as a conventional precipitation-strengthened superalloy.
The HW-1 alloy had the standard WASAPLOY composition, while the others had higher contents of g%. The relationship between the content of g% and Al Ti is shown in Table 2.
